item.title: SIC-POVMs in every dimension, formalized in Lean 4
item.description: A machine-checked Lean 4 proof that SIC-POVMs exist in every finite dimension, the existence part of Zauner's conjecture. It follows the proof of Radchenko and Wheeler, with a theorem of Appleby, Flammia and Kopp. Written by AI agents under human direction. Accepted by six kernels.
